geeklist.title: Small, quick auction! (# 54) - US only - Ends 11-20-25
geeklist.description:
[size=18][b][u]RULES[/u][/b]:[/size]
[b]:arrowE:DATE:[/b] This US only auction will [b][size=14][BGCOLOR=#FFFF00]END[/BGCOLOR][/size][/b] sometime on [b] [size=14][BGCOLOR=#FFFF00] November 20, 2025[/BGCOLOR][/size][/b].
[b]:arrowE:CONDITION[/b]: All games are in English, unless otherwise specified. All games are considered to be in "very good" condition, unless otherwise specified. Assume there will be some minor dings or slight shelfwear, although the majority probably don't have either of these, and are in like-new condition, actually. The game may or may not come with its original insert, if it even had one at all. If you must know further specifics about a certain game, please [geekurl=/geekmail/compose?touser=feldfan2014][b]GM me![/b][/geekurl]
[b]:arrowE:BIDDING[/b]: Please bid in whole dollars only. [COLOR=#0000FF]Starting bids[/COLOR] are exactly that, so please don't bid lower than that value, since I will not consider any such bid. There will not be any "[COLOR=#FF0000]BIN[/COLOR]" ("buy it now") bids for this auction. I will strongly consider bundle discounts at my discretion for multiple items won.
[b][i][size=18]*** [u][color=#ff0033]Please include your zip code when making your bid, so speed up the process of calculating shipping at the end of the auction, which will help get you your game(s) faster.[/color] [/u] *** [/size][/i][/b]
[b]:arrowE:SHIPPING[/b]: The winner(s) will be responsible for all shipping costs. I will ship to the USA only. Shipping will be through USPS or UPS (using PirateShip for the best deals when possible). [b][i]Assume an average of $13-15 for shipping of a single, regular-sized game. If this range is not acceptable, please do not bid.[/i][/b] If you win multiple items, then I will combine shipping (when possible - see any exceptions in individual listings) to help save you money on postage costs. For those who live [i]relatively[/i] closer to me in the Northwest, and/or for smaller games, shipping will certainly be cheaper. Barring any unforeseen circumstances, I will usually ship within 24 hours of receiving payment. Local pick-up is available (98944), but I am fairly confident none of you even live that close to me. :)
[b]:arrowE:PAYMENTS[/b]: This will be done via PayPal. [b][i]For new users or those with minimal-to-no BGG activity, sales or trade feedback, or simply at my discretion, I will only accept this through the "Friends and Family" option[/i][/b]. Once you have agreed to purchase the item and payment details have been worked out, please send payment within 48 hours, or I have the right to cancel your bid. If you have any questions about payment, please [geekurl=/geekmail/compose?touser=feldfan2014][b]GM me.[/b][/geekurl]
[b]:arrowE:MISCELLANEOUS[/b]: [c] [/c]* Although I do not expect to do so, I reserve the right to remove any item at any time. [c] [/c]* I also reserve the right to refuse anyone's bid, at my discretion. For you to whom I may be referring, you should [c] [/c]know who you are, and you are probably not bidding on anything here anyway.
[c] [/c][b][size=14] * * * [color=#ff0000]I have sold hundreds of items, with perfect seller feedback. I take pride in my packing of games, so they arrive safely, without damage. PLEASE BID WITH CONFIDENCE!!![/color] * * *[/size][/b]
[c] [/c] [size=12][i]Please feel free to [geekurl=/geekmail/compose?touser=feldfan2014]GM me[/geekurl] with any questions, and thanks for looking/bidding![/i][/size]
